0.en: The sponge touched the drop, and nothing happened.
0.id: Spons itu menyentuh tetesan, dan tidak terjadi apa-apa.

1.en: Jack had braced for it to burst. It didn't. The surface flexed like the skin of a balloon, and the yellow sponge sank into it and disappeared.
1.id: Jack sudah bersiap tetesan itu akan pecah. Ternyata tidak. Permukaannya melentur seperti kulit balon, dan spons kuning itu tenggelam ke dalamnya lalu lenyap.

2.en: Then the water began to move. The drop shrank around the sponge the way a puddle vanishes into a towel. When it stopped, the sponge hung dark and heavy at the end of the pole, and the drop looked hardly any smaller.
2.id: Lalu airnya mulai bergerak. Tetesan itu menyusut di sekeliling spons seperti genangan yang lenyap ke dalam handuk. Ketika berhenti, spons itu menggantung gelap dan berat di ujung tiang, dan tetesan itu nyaris tidak tampak mengecil.

5.en: Mark's voice came from right behind him, low and even.
5.id: Suara Mark terdengar tepat dari belakangnya, rendah dan datar.

7.en: Jack drew the pole in hand over hand, keeping the far end level. Water dripped from the sponge in fat beads that didn't splash so much as land.
7.id: Jack menarik tiang itu tangan demi tangan, menjaga ujung yang jauh tetap datar. Air menetes dari spons dalam butiran gemuk yang bukan memercik, melainkan mendarat.

8.en: Aiden held the funnel up. Mark took the sponge in both gloved hands and twisted. Water poured into the funnel and gurgled down into the jug.
8.id: Aiden mengangkat corong. Mark menerima spons dengan kedua tangan bersarung dan memerasnya. Air tercurah ke corong dan berdeguk turun ke dalam jeriken.

9.en: Lena's voice came on Jack's wrist.
9.id: Suara Lena terdengar di pergelangan Jack.

13.en: The second pass was faster. The third was faster still. On the fourth, Jack felt something cold at his wrist and looked down. A sheet of water had crept down the length of the pole from the sponge, thin and clear, and was sliding toward his hands.
13.id: Putaran kedua lebih cepat. Putaran ketiga lebih cepat lagi. Pada putaran keempat, Jack merasakan sesuatu yang dingin di pergelangannya dan menunduk. Selapis air sudah merambat menuruni sepanjang tiang dari spons, tipis dan bening, dan sedang meluncur ke arah tangannya.

14.en: Aiden saw it at the same moment.
14.id: Aiden melihatnya pada saat yang sama.

15.en: Wipe it. Don't let it reach the glove.
15.id: Seka. Jangan sampai kena sarung tangan.

16.en: Jack wiped it with the rag on his belt. It came right back.
16.id: Jack menyekanya dengan lap di ikat pinggangnya. Air itu langsung datang lagi.

17.en: Between passes, Aiden crouched at the very edge of the asphalt with a glass vial taped to a short stick. He chose a small drop along the edge of a low blade and touched the vial to it. The water ran in on its own. He capped it and slid it into the inside pocket of his jacket.
17.id: Di sela-sela putaran, Aiden berjongkok di tepi paling ujung aspal dengan sebuah tabung kaca kecil yang direkatkan ke tongkat pendek. Ia memilih setetes air kecil di sepanjang tepi sehelai daun yang rendah dan menyentuhkan tabung itu ke sana. Airnya masuk sendiri. Ia menutup tabung itu dan menyelipkannya ke saku dalam jaketnya.

18.en: Dew. Not the plant's water. That's the one I want to test.
18.id: Embun. Bukan air tanamannya. Yang ini yang mau kuuji.

19.en: Mark nodded without looking at him.

20.en: Good. Now stay off that edge.

21.en: Aiden shuffled back half a step, and then he stopped. He was looking at a drop low on the same blade, no bigger than a beach ball.
21.id: Aiden bergeser mundur setengah langkah, lalu berhenti. Ia sedang memandangi setetes air di bagian bawah helai yang sama, tak lebih besar dari bola pantai.

22.id: Ada sesuatu di dalam yang itu.

23.en: Half sunk in it, bent out of shape by the water, was a dark body the size of a cat, its wings flattened back.
23.id: Setengah terbenam di dalamnya, bentuknya terdistorsi oleh air, ada tubuh gelap sebesar kucing, sayapnya rebah ke belakang.

24.en: A midge. It's been stuck there all night.
24.id: Agas. Sudah terjebak di sana semalaman.

27.en: The sun came up behind them.

28.en: It touched the top of the grass first, gold and sudden, and every drop on the wall of stems caught fire at once.
28.id: Sinarnya menyentuh pucuk rumput lebih dulu, keemasan dan tiba-tiba, dan setiap tetesan di dinding batang rumput itu menyala serentak.

29.en: Then, high in the stems, the pale silk bag moved.
29.id: Lalu, tinggi di antara batang-batang rumput, kantong sutra pucat itu bergerak.

30.en: Mark's voice dropped to almost nothing.
30.id: Suara Mark turun hingga nyaris tak terdengar.

32.en: Jack stopped. The pole was half extended, the sponge dripping above the asphalt. Aiden stopped in a crouch. Somewhere behind them, Jack heard the rope creak as Unit Four took up the slack.
32.id: Jack berhenti. Tiangnya terjulur setengah, spons meneteskan air di atas aspal. Aiden berhenti dalam posisi jongkok. Di suatu tempat di belakang mereka, Jack mendengar tali berderit saat Unit Empat menarik kendurnya.

33.en: The spider came out of its retreat legs first, exactly as it had on Sarah's footage. It climbed down the stem in short, careful steps and stopped in the light, a meter or two above the big drop, and was still.
33.id: Laba-laba itu keluar dari tempat persembunyiannya dengan kaki lebih dulu, persis seperti dalam rekaman Sarah. Ia menuruni batang rumput dengan langkah-langkah pendek yang hati-hati lalu berhenti di bawah cahaya, satu atau dua meter di atas tetesan besar itu, dan diam.

34.en: Jack could see its eyes, two enormous ones in front, dark and glossy, and smaller ones around them.
34.id: Jack bisa melihat matanya, dua yang sangat besar di depan, gelap dan mengilap, dan yang lebih kecil di sekelilingnya.

35.en: Lena's voice whispered from his wrist.

37.en: He didn't. The spider sat. The sun climbed. Jack's arms began to burn from holding the pole out over nothing, and he didn't lower it.
37.id: Ia tidak menjawab. Laba-laba itu diam. Matahari naik. Lengan Jack mulai terasa terbakar karena menjulurkan tiang di atas kehampaan, dan ia tidak menurunkannya.

38.en: Lena's voice came again, softer still.
38.id: Suara Lena terdengar lagi, lebih pelan lagi.

40.en: Below the spider, the midge moved.
40.id: Di bawah laba-laba itu, si agas bergerak.

41.en: It was only a twitch at first, one leg. Then a wing shivered against the inside of the drop, and then the whole midge was struggling, warmed by the same sun, beating itself against water it could not break.
41.id: Awalnya hanya kedutan, satu kaki. Lalu sebelah sayap bergetar di sisi dalam tetesan, lalu seluruh tubuh agas itu meronta, dihangatkan oleh matahari yang sama, membentur-benturkan diri ke air yang tak bisa ia tembus.

42.en: The spider's front eyes turned toward it.
42.id: Mata depan laba-laba itu berputar ke arahnya.

43.en: Jack had seen it happen once before, on the greenhouse roof, and he still didn't see it now. One moment the spider was on the stem. The next, it was on the blade, right on top of the struggling drop, and the whole blade bent under its weight like a branch under a cat.
43.id: Jack pernah melihatnya terjadi sekali, di atap rumah kaca, dan sekarang pun ia tetap tidak melihatnya. Sesaat laba-laba itu ada di batang. Sesaat kemudian, ia sudah di helai daun, tepat di atas tetesan yang meronta itu, dan seluruh helai melengkung di bawah bobotnya seperti dahan di bawah seekor kucing.

44.en: Every drop along the leaf shivered. The big one at the tip slid.
44.id: Setiap tetesan di sepanjang daun itu bergetar. Tetesan besar di ujungnya bergeser.

45.en: It slid slowly at first, like a raindrop on a windshield, and then it came off the end of the leaf all at once and fell.
45.id: Mula-mula bergeser pelan, seperti tetes hujan di kaca depan mobil, lalu tiba-tiba lepas dari ujung daun sekaligus dan jatuh.

46.en: It hit the edge of the asphalt a meter from Aiden and didn't splash. It landed like a wave. Aiden was crouching, and a wall of water came across the asphalt knee-high, clear as glass, and swept him off his feet. It folded over him and kept going, sliding toward the edge, toward the soil, and he went with it.
46.id: Tetesan itu menghantam tepi aspal satu meter dari Aiden dan tidak memercik. Ia mendarat seperti ombak. Aiden sedang berjongkok, dan sebuah dinding air setinggi lutut menyapu melintasi aspal, bening seperti kaca, dan menjatuhkannya. Air itu menelungkup menimpanya dan terus bergerak, meluncur ke arah tepian, ke arah tanah, dan Aiden ikut terbawa.

47.en: Mark's voice cracked like a whip.

49.en: The rope snapped tight. Jack dropped the pole and grabbed for Aiden's harness. His hand closed on a strap under the water, and the cold went straight through the glove and the bag and into the stitches. The water didn't let go. It clung to Aiden's jacket and his legs and his face, heavy and slick, pulling him toward the soil.
49.id: Tali menegang dengan sentakan. Jack menjatuhkan tiang dan menyambar harnes Aiden. Tangannya mencengkeram sebuah tali pengikat di bawah air, dan dinginnya langsung menembus sarung tangan dan kantong plastik sampai ke jahitannya. Air itu tidak mau melepaskan. Air menempel di jaket Aiden dan kakinya dan wajahnya, berat dan licin, menariknya ke arah tanah.

50.en: Unit Four pulled. Mark pulled. Jack pulled. Aiden came back across the road in a long, slow slide. The water came with him for a meter, then two. Then it finally let go and ran off the edge into the soil.
50.id: Unit Empat menarik. Mark menarik. Jack menarik. Aiden kembali melintasi jalan dalam luncuran panjang yang lambat. Air itu ikut bersamanya satu meter, lalu dua. Lalu akhirnya melepaskannya dan mengalir lewat tepian ke dalam tanah.

51.en: Aiden lay on his back, coughing, his jacket so heavy with water that he couldn't sit up.
51.id: Aiden terbaring telentang, terbatuk-batuk, jaketnya begitu berat oleh air sampai ia tidak bisa duduk.

52.en: Above them, on the bent blade, the spider had the midge.
52.id: Di atas mereka, di helai daun yang melengkung, laba-laba itu sudah mendapatkan si agas.

53.en: It turned its head. The big front eyes swung down toward Aiden, toward the thrashing, toward the noise.
53.id: Ia menoleh. Mata depannya yang besar berayun turun ke arah Aiden, ke arah rontaan itu, ke arah keributan itu.

56.en: Aiden stopped. Water ran out of his sleeves. He stared up at the spider, and the spider stared down at him, and for a long, long moment nobody breathed.
56.id: Aiden berhenti. Air mengalir keluar dari lengan bajunya. Ia menatap laba-laba itu, dan laba-laba itu menatapnya balik, dan untuk waktu yang sangat, sangat lama, tak ada yang bernapas.

57.en: Then the spider turned away. It climbed back up the stem with the midge held in front of it, slowly, one step at a time, and disappeared into the silk bag.
57.id: Lalu laba-laba itu berpaling. Ia memanjat kembali batang rumput dengan agas tergenggam di depannya, pelan, selangkah demi selangkah, dan lenyap ke dalam kantong sutra.

58.en: Mark's voice was quiet and final.
58.id: Suara Mark pelan dan tak bisa ditawar.

59.en: We're done. Back to the cart.

60.en: They walked to the cart without hurrying. Mark carried the jug, and the pole he had dragged back off the edge. Jack and Unit Four half carried Aiden between them. Aiden's teeth had started to chatter so hard he couldn't talk. Unit Four peeled the jacket off him at the vehicle and wrapped him in the blanket from the back seat.
60.id: Mereka berjalan ke kereta tanpa terburu-buru. Mark membawa jeriken, dan tiang yang sudah ia seret kembali dari tepian. Jack dan Unit Empat setengah memapah Aiden di antara mereka. Gigi Aiden mulai bergemeletuk begitu keras sampai ia tak bisa bicara. Di kendaraan, Unit Empat melepaskan jaket itu darinya dan membungkusnya dengan selimut dari kursi belakang.

61.en: Aiden fumbled in the wet jacket and came up with the vial. Still capped. Still full.
61.id: Aiden merogoh-rogoh jaket yang basah itu dan mengeluarkan tabungnya. Masih tertutup. Masih penuh.

63.en: Sarah's voice came over the channel, very quiet.
63.id: Suara Sarah terdengar di kanal, sangat pelan.

67.en: Jack looked down at his left hand. Water had gotten in under the tape.
67.id: Jack menunduk memandang tangan kirinya. Air sudah masuk ke bawah plesternya.

68.en: I'm about to be in trouble with Doctor Mercer.
68.id: Sebentar lagi aku kena masalah dengan Dokter Mercer.

69.en: I already called her. She's meeting you at the station. And she says the station counts as straight to her, this once.
69.id: Aku sudah meneleponnya. Dia akan menemuimu di stasiun. Dan katanya stasiun dihitung sebagai langsung ke dia, untuk kali ini.

70.en: Half an hour later, back at the utility station, the jug sat on the floor between them. It held twelve liters.
70.id: Setengah jam kemudian, di stasiun utilitas, jeriken itu berdiri di lantai di antara mereka. Isinya dua belas liter.

71.en: Aiden sat by the warm pipes wrapped in two blankets and a borrowed sweater, running his sample through the greenhouse water tests. Lena stood over him. Mark stood in the doorway, where he always stood.
71.id: Aiden duduk di dekat pipa-pipa yang hangat, terbungkus dua selimut dan sweter pinjaman, menjalankan sampelnya lewat uji air rumah kaca. Lena berdiri di dekatnya, mengawasi. Mark berdiri di ambang pintu, tempat ia selalu berdiri.

72.id: Aiden menyipitkan mata menatap strip itu.

73.en: Low minerals. Low salt. It's dew, all right. Clean enough to filter and boil. Whether there's anything living in it, I can't tell you today. That takes longer.
73.id: Mineral rendah. Garam rendah. Memang embun. Cukup bersih untuk disaring dan direbus. Apakah ada yang hidup di dalamnya, aku belum bisa bilang hari ini. Itu butuh waktu lebih lama.

74.en: Jack sat on a crate across from him, his hand wrapped in a dry towel while he waited for Doctor Mercer, and looked at the jug.
74.id: Jack duduk di atas peti di seberangnya, tangannya terbungkus handuk kering sambil menunggu Dokter Mercer, dan memandang jeriken itu.

75.en: Twelve liters. Half an hour. And we nearly lost you.
75.id: Dua belas liter. Setengah jam. Dan kami hampir kehilangan kamu.

76.id: Aiden mengangkat bahu di balik selimutnya.

78.en: Mark didn't move from the doorway.
78.id: Mark tidak beranjak dari ambang pintu.

79.en: We're not doing that every morning. I'm telling you now.
79.id: Kita tidak akan melakukan itu setiap pagi. Kubilang sekarang.

82.en: We need fifteen thousand a day.
82.id: Kita butuh lima belas ribu sehari.

83.en: Which is why we can't do it with a stick.
83.id: Makanya kita tidak bisa melakukannya pakai tongkat.

84.en: Jack closed his eyes, and saw it again. The spider landing. The blade bending. The drop sliding off the tip, and falling, and coming down onto the road.
84.id: Jack memejamkan mata, dan melihatnya lagi. Laba-laba itu mendarat. Helai daun melengkung. Tetesan itu meluncur lepas dari ujungnya, jatuh, dan turun ke jalan.

89.en: We spent half an hour reaching up for it with a stick. Then the blade bent, and it fell on its own, right onto the asphalt. We don't need to reach the water. We need to make it come down. Shake the blade, and let it fall onto something that catches it.
89.id: Kita menghabiskan setengah jam menjangkaunya ke atas pakai tongkat. Lalu helai daunnya melengkung, dan tetesan itu jatuh sendiri, tepat ke aspal. Kita tidak perlu menjangkau airnya. Kita perlu membuatnya turun. Goyangkan helai daunnya, dan biarkan airnya jatuh ke sesuatu yang bisa menampungnya.

90.en: Lena was already reaching for a pen.

91.en: A trough. Along the end of the road, under the leaf tips.
91.id: Talang. Di sepanjang ujung jalan, di bawah ujung-ujung daun.

96.en: Could you make us a trough? Long, shallow, sitting on the asphalt at the end of the western road.
96.id: Bisa buatkan kami talang? Panjang, dangkal, diletakkan di atas aspal di ujung jalan barat.

97.en: A gutter. Yes. Give me a day. And I'm putting a collar on that pole of yours. I watched the feed. Water running down to your hands like that, it's a wonder it didn't grab a fistful of you.
97.id: Talang air. Bisa. Beri saya satu hari. Dan saya akan memasang kerah di tiang kalian itu. Saya menonton tayangannya. Air merambat turun ke tangan seperti itu, heran airnya tidak sampai mencengkeram kalian segenggam penuh.

99.en: Don't thank me. Bump my coolant.
99.id: Jangan berterima kasih. Naikkan cairan pendingin saya.

101.en: Sarah's voice came over Jack's wrist a moment later, softer than the room.
101.id: Suara Sarah terdengar dari pergelangan Jack sesaat kemudian, lebih lembut daripada suasana ruangan.

102.en: It's seven fifty. You said nine.
102.id: Sekarang jam tujuh lima puluh. Kamu bilang jam sembilan.

103.en: I'm early. Don't get used to it.
103.id: Aku datang lebih awal. Jangan dibiasakan.

104.en: There was a short pause on the line, and he could hear her smiling.
104.id: Sambungan itu hening sejenak, dan Jack bisa mendengar Sarah tersenyum.

105.en: He kicked. When you said you were coming back.
105.id: Dia menendang. Waktu kamu bilang kamu sedang pulang.

106.en: Jack held his wrist a little closer.

107.en: Tell him I heard. No. I'll tell him myself. Tonight.
107.id: Bilang padanya aku dengar. Jangan. Aku sendiri yang akan bilang. Nanti malam.

108.en: Across the room, Aiden had stopped shivering. He was staring at the floor, the vial still clutched in his fist. Then he looked up.
108.id: Di seberang ruangan, Aiden sudah berhenti menggigil. Ia menatap lantai, tabung itu masih tergenggam di kepalannya. Lalu ia mendongak.

109.en: It watched us. The whole time. Every pass with the pole, every time you swung it back. It knew exactly where we were. So why didn't it come for us?
109.id: Dia mengawasi kita. Sepanjang waktu. Setiap putaran tiang, setiap kali kamu mengayunnya balik. Dia tahu persis di mana kita berada. Jadi kenapa dia tidak mendatangi kita?

110.en: Mark answered from the doorway, quietly.
110.id: Mark menjawab dari ambang pintu, pelan.

112.en: Aiden nodded slowly. Then, hesitantly, he shook his head.
112.id: Aiden mengangguk pelan. Lalu, ragu-ragu, ia menggeleng.

113.en: Not slow. Boring. The midge wasn't.
113.id: Bukan pelan. Membosankan. Si agas tidak.

114.en: Mark looked from Aiden to Jack.

115.en: Which is the problem with your trough. Shaking grass isn't boring. Shaking grass is fast. And fast is food.
115.id: Dan itu masalahnya dengan talangmu. Menggoyang rumput itu tidak membosankan. Menggoyang rumput itu cepat. Dan cepat itu makanan.

116.en: Then we do it in the gray. Before the sun. Before it's warm.
116.id: Kalau begitu kita lakukan saat masih kelabu. Sebelum matahari. Sebelum hangat.

117.en: Mark didn't say yes. He didn't say no, either. He looked up at the station's high window, where the last of the drops on the grass were already shrinking in the sun, and Jack could see him starting a new list.
117.id: Mark tidak bilang ya. Ia juga tidak bilang tidak. Ia mendongak ke jendela tinggi stasiun, tempat tetesan-tetesan terakhir di rumput sudah mulai menyusut di bawah matahari, dan Jack bisa melihatnya mulai menyusun daftar baru.
